name: The Ashen Oath
tagline: Freedom is an order you give yourself.
description: Lead Orin’s unbound dead out of servitude. Escape a quarry, defend a refuge, and break the Master’s bindings with unexpected living allies.
shortDescription: The dead have broken their chains—but their Master wants them back.

dialogue.text: What should I put in the new ledger?

ending.text: Names first. And leave a blank page. We may become more than you expected.
